findings.title: The first keystroke(s) after inserting a page break land at the pre-insert caret position (before the break, on the old page) even though the caret is visibly placed on the new page
findings.repro: 1) Fresh doc, two paragraphs 'ParaAlpha text one' / 'ParaBeta text two'. 2) Click into the editor, press Control+End (caret at end of ParaBeta). 3) Insert ribbon → 'Insert a page break'. 4) Immediately type (e.g. 'J'). 5) Inspect: the typed characters append to 'ParaBeta text two' BEFORE the '<!-- np3:pb -->' spacer; the empty paragraph created after the spacer (where the caret was visibly placed) stays empty.
findings.expected: Typing after inserting a page break goes after the break (new page), matching the caret the app itself placed via placeCaretStart.
findings.observed: 3 reproductions: typed 'QUOTE' (5 chars), 'Z', 'J' all landed before the break; markdown order '…ParaBeta text twoQUOTEZYJ\n\n<!-- np3:pb -->…' while the DOM caret (evaluated immediately after insert, before typing) sat in the new empty paragraph after the spacer (anchor text empty, offset 0, editor focused).
findings.controls: (a) Same pipeline WITHOUT the break insert: pressed 'K' landed exactly at the live DOM selection (offset 1 mid-paragraph) — proves press-input honors the live selection normally. (b) Mid-paragraph caret + failed-insert control: 'K' landed at offset 1. (c) Post-insert caret eval proves the DOM selection is in the new paragraph at insert time.
findings.sourceMechanism: app-js.txt final pageBreak override (bookmark-based: 'pageBreak=function(){let bookmark=selectionBookmark();…withMutation(()=>{const r=rangeFromBookmark(bookmark)||getRange();…block.after(pb,next);placeCaretStart(next);lastEditorRange=getRange()?.cloneRange()…})') — the spacer insertion and caret placement are correct, but the app's next-input anchor (selectionBookmark/lastEditorRange captured at mousedown on the .pop menu, per document mousedown preventDefault handler that keeps editor focus, plus flushCommit→normalizeDom inside withMutation) re-anchors the following keystroke at the stale pre-insert bookmark. Exact stale variable not fully pinned; behavior discrimination is empirical.
findings.impact: Silent wrong placement: text the user types right after inserting a page break goes onto the old page before the break (opposite of Word parity); they must notice and manually re-click after the break. Fix: after pageBreak's mutation, refresh the input bookmark (selectionBookmark/lastEditorRange) from the post-insert caret.

findings.title: B135-family extension: a page break inserted while the caret is inside a list item is placed after the entire list instead of at the caret
findings.classification: CONFIRMED (extension of known B135 pattern — new trigger route)
findings.repro: 1) Doc with a 3-item bulleted list (alpha/beta/gamma). 2) Put the caret in 'List item beta' (verified via selection anchor eval). 3) Insert ribbon → 'Insert a page break'. 4) Inspect markdown: '<!-- np3:pb -->' is appended after 'List item gamma' (end of UL), not between beta and gamma.
findings.expected: Break at the caret position (splitting the list across pages, Word parity) — or at minimum between the caret's item and the next.
findings.observed: pb inserted after the whole UL; list unsplit (lis:3 before and after).
findings.controls: caret anchor eval proved the caret was inside 'beta' at insert time; same insert at paragraph-level caret splits correctly at the caret.
findings.sourceMechanism: app-js.txt pageBreak: closestTopBlock(r.startContainer) resolves to the UL for a caret in an LI; the P|H1-6 split branch is skipped and 'block.after(pb)' places the spacer after the whole list. Same block-escape shape as B135 (slash Table after whole list/quote).
findings.impact: User cannot insert a page break inside a list at a chosen item; the whole list stays on one page and the break goes to its end. Fix: resolve LI-level blocks (split the list or insert within the LI's own text flow).

findings.title: Reload of a document whose markdown begins with a page break renders an extra empty leading paragraph that was not present in the live session
findings.repro:
1) Insert a page break at the very start of a document with content (live DOM: first

is the heading; markdown ' …heading…'). 2) Reload. 3) First

in the editor is now EMPTY; the heading is the second paragraph.
findings.expected: Re-rendered DOM matches the pre-reload DOM (heading first).
findings.observed:
Phantom empty first

after reload; markdown byte-identical pre/post (mdLen 878 both) so it does not re-serialize — pure MD.render artifact for a leading pb comment.
findings.controls: doc without a leading break shows no phantom paragraph after switch/reload.
findings.sourceMechanism: MD.render emits an empty paragraph for the leading comment-only block before the pb spacer div (app-js.txt render path: '…np3:pb\s*-->$/.test(line)){flush();html+='<div class="np3-pb"…' — the flush() before the spacer emits the empty leading paragraph).
findings.impact: One extra empty line at the top of page 1 after reload; no data corruption. Fix: skip emitting the empty block when only comments precede a leading pb.
